description: Defines type traits and utility templates for handling integral types, enums, and type relationships within the Android media foundation codebase.

classes.name: is_integral_or_enum
classes.description: Checks if a type is an integral type or an enum.

classes.name: underlying_integral_type
classes.description: Provides the underlying integral type for enums or the same type for integral types.

classes.name: is_signed_integral
classes.description: Checks if the underlying integral type is signed.

classes.name: is_unsigned_integral
classes.description: Checks if the underlying integral type is unsigned.

classes.name: is_one_of
classes.description: Determines if a type is among a list of types.

classes.name: are_unique
classes.description: Checks if all types in a list are unique.

classes.name: find_first
classes.description: Finds the first occurrence index of a type in a list.

classes.name: find_first_convertible_to
classes.description: Finds the first type in a list that a given type can be implicitly converted into.
